jobs.title: Trainer
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role, you will manage the implementation and ongoing development of all aspects of processing training including safety, workplace inductions, personal development and training for personnel within the Process Plant.
To ensure that all activities meet the K92 Mining business needs and consistently high standards of occupational health, safety and environment are met, you will ensure the continuous improvement of safety best practice in line with K92 Mining Safety System and Environmental Policies and Procedures
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Manage scheduling of training for all Process plant personnel.
Co-ordinate or conduct Process Plant inductions and / or safety training
Maintain up to date training matrix for all Processing employees
Oversee graduate development programs within the Processing department
Monitor training provided for Processing personnel and develop effective training materials, evaluations and record keeping systems consistent with existing site document control.
Ensure accurate training records are maintained.
Accurately identify training requirements for all Processing personnel through effective Training Needs Analysis, Performance Management data and through liaison with key personnel and attending appropriate meetings.
Further the development of competency assessments for all Processing personnel.
Undertake the design and continuous development of training modules, materials, and procedures.
Liaise closely with the Coordinator Training and Development (Master Trainer) and other training personnel to maximise consistency and maintain a uniform approach to training across site.
Actively promote a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrate personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess an appropriate Trade Certification with a Diploma in Tech Teaching or a Certificate IV in Workplace Training
Have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in technical training role in a mineral processing plant.
Prior experience in a supervisory role.
Well-developed computer skills with competence in MS Office Suite and Pronto.
Well-developed interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills in English
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

jobs.title: Senior Mechanic (Heavy Equipment)
jobs.description:
Summary
The Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing a wide range of heavy machinery used in construction, mining, and other industrial sectors. This role requires extensive knowledge of heavy equipment mechanics, hydraulics, and electronics, along with a commitment to safety and efficiency.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conduct regular maintenance and repair on heavy equipment such as bulldozers, cranes, excavators, and loaders.
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues including hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical systems.
Perform complex repairs and component replacements, ensuring equipment operates efficiently and safely.
Lead and mentor junior mechanics in repair techniques and preventive maintenance of heavy machinery.
Oversee the maintenance records and inventory of parts and supplies for heavy equipment.
Collaborate with equipment operators to understand equipment issues and provide effective solutions.
Stay updated with the latest technological advancements in heavy machinery and repair techniques.
Ensure compliance with all safety guidelines and regulations during maintenance and repair operations.
Coordinate with the management team to plan and schedule maintenance activities and minimize equipment downtime.
Provide emergency repair service as needed to prevent delays in project timelines.
Job Requirements
Advanced diploma or equivalent in mechanics, heavy equipment maintenance, or related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in heavy equipment repair and maintenance.
In-depth knowledge of heavy equipment systems, including hydraulic, electronic, and engine components.
Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and equipment for heavy machinery.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
Strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor team members.
Commitment to maintaining a safe work environment, with knowledge of OSHA safety standards.
Physical ability to handle heavy equipment and work in various environmental conditions.
Flexibility to respond to emergency repair requests outside of standard working hours.
Others
Joining our team as a Senior Mechanic specializing in Heavy Equipment offers a challenging yet rewarding career path, where you will be instrumental in ensuring the functionality and reliability of critical machinery. We value dedication, skill, and a strong work ethic, and provide opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

jobs.title: Security Admin Receptionist
jobs.industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Operations Support, Security
jobs.description:
Summary
The Security Admin Receptionist is the first point of contact for all visitors, staff, and contractors, combining front desk hospitality with administrative and security responsibilities. This role ensures a professional, safe, and orderly workplace by managing visitor access, enforcing grooming and conduct policies, and maintaining a clean, presentable environment at all times.
Key responsibilities include welcoming guests, verifying appointments, issuing passes through the digital Visitor Management System (VMS), handling incident reports, and coordinating with security, facilities, and cleaning teams. The receptionist is responsible for ensuring that all toilets are cleaned regularly by the professional cleaning teams and that cleaning logs are properly maintained and updated.
The ideal candidate is tech-savvy, embraces a paperless environment, upholds a strict clear desk policy, and demonstrates high integrity, etiquette, and confidence when dealing with both internal and external stakeholders.
Duties and Responsibilities
Greet and register visitors; verify appointments and issue visitor passes through the Visitor Management System (VMS).
Ensure visitor and contractor passes are issued in accordance with the approved listing and company protocols.
Be the first point of contact for contractors and visitors; explain site rules and escort or direct them appropriately.
Answer and direct phone calls; handle incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries.
Maintain accurate logs for visitors, deliveries, incidents, and other security-related activities.
Prepare and submit incident reports; follow up on resolutions and escalations as needed.
Work fully digitally using tablets or computers; maintain a clear desk policy at all times.
Support administrative needs of the department and coordinate with other departments when required.
Ensure the reception and ground floor area is clean and presentable at all times; remove any visible rubbish immediately.
Serve refreshments to visitors and ensure meeting rooms are clean, arranged, and ready for use.
Ensure professional cleaning teams attend to all toilets regularly; monitor and update cleaning logs accordingly.
Remind employees and visitors of the company grooming policy when necessary.
Report any facility issues to the Admin or Facilities team for prompt resolution.
Job Requirements
Certificate or Diploma in Business Administration or equivalent required.
1–3 years of experience in a receptionist, administrative support, or security-related role.
Previous experience in a corporate, hospitality, or security environment is an advantage.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Professional, respectful, and courteous demeanor with a strong focus on customer service.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Tech-savvy with strong adaptability to digital tools and paperless processes.
Demonstrates good judgment, tact, and confidence when engaging with all levels of staff and visitors.
High level of integrity, honesty, and accountability in all responsibilities.
Basic understanding of safety and security protocols.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
Must pass background checks and obtain security clearance if required.
Others
Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
Flexibility to work varied shifts, including weekends, if required.
Must be dependable, punctual, and maintain a professional appearance at all times.

jobs.industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Property and Real Estate
jobs.description:
Summary
The Landscaper will be responsible for the maintenance and enhancement of the grounds and outdoor spaces of our residential and commercial properties. This role involves a variety of tasks including planting, trimming, mowing, and general landscape upkeep. The ideal candidate will have a strong knowledge of horticulture, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for outdoor work.
Duties and Responsibilities
Landscaping Maintenance:
Perform routine lawn care tasks such as mowing, edging, weeding, and trimming.
Plant and maintain flowers, shrubs, trees, and other greenery.
Apply fertilizers, pesticides, and other treatments to maintain healthy landscapes.
Prune and trim trees and shrubs to maintain shape and remove damaged or diseased branches.
Groundskeeping:
Maintain cleanliness and appearance of outdoor areas, including picking up trash and debris.
Ensure walkways, driveways, and outdoor structures are clear and well-maintained.
Inspect irrigation systems and perform minor repairs as needed.
Assist with the installation and maintenance of outdoor features such as lighting, benches, and decorative elements.
Equipment Operation and Maintenance:
Operate and maintain landscaping equipment, including mowers, trimmers, blowers, and other tools.
Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Seasonal Tasks:
Perform seasonal landscaping tasks such as leaf removal, snow removal, and winterizing plants and irrigation systems.
Assist with special projects and events as needed, including holiday decorations and property beautification efforts.
Job Requirements
Experience:
Proven experience in landscaping, groundskeeping, or a related field.
Knowledge:
Strong understanding of horticulture principles and landscape maintenance techniques.
Skills:
Proficiency with landscaping tools and equipment. Basic mechanical skills for equipment maintenance.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting, bending, and working in various weather conditions.
Communication Skills:
Good communication skills and ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team.
Attention to Detail:
High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of work.
Driver's License:
Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.

jobs.description:
Summary
The Genset Maintenance Technician is responsible for the preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and servicing of diesel and gas-powered generators across company facilities. This role ensures reliable backup power supply, compliance with safety standards, and optimal performance of all generator sets (gensets).
Duties and Responsibilities
1. Generator Maintenance & Servicing
Perform
scheduled preventive maintenance
(oil changes, filter replacements, coolant checks, battery testing).
Conduct
load bank testing
to verify generator performance under load.
Inspect and maintain
fuel systems, cooling systems, exhaust systems, and electrical components
.
2. Troubleshooting & Repairs
Diagnose and repair
mechanical failures
(engine issues, fuel injectors, turbochargers, belts, pumps).
Troubleshoot
electrical faults
(AVR, control panels, wiring, circuit breakers, voltage regulators).
Replace defective parts and ensure proper reassembly and testing.
3. Emergency Response
Provide
24/7 on-call support
for generator failures and power outages.
Rapidly diagnose issues and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
4. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain detailed
service logs, work orders, and maintenance records
(CMMS or manual logs).
Ensure compliance with
OSHA, NFPA 110, EPA emissions, and company safety policies
.
Track
fuel consumption, runtime hours, and spare parts inventory
.
5. Installation & Commissioning Support
Assist in
new generator installations, ATS setups, and synchronization checks
.
Verify proper operation before handover to operations.
Job Requirements
High school diploma or equivalent
(required).
Technical certification
in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Generator Maintenance, or related field (preferred).
Manufacturer certifications
(Cummins, Kohler, Caterpillar, Generac) are a plus.
3+ years
of hands-on experience in
generator maintenance and repair
.
Familiarity with
diesel/gas generators (10kVA – 2000kVA+)
.
Knowledge of
ATS, load banks, and paralleling systems
.
Mechanical:
Engine diagnostics (compression tests, fuel system troubleshooting). Ability to disassemble, repair, and reassemble generator components.
Electrical:
Proficiency with
multimeters, meggers, and diagnostic tools
. Understanding of
control panels, wiring diagrams, and synchronization
.
Soft Skills:
Strong problem-solving and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Good communication for reporting and team coordination.
Field Work:
On-site servicing at multiple locations.
Physical Demands:
Lifting (25 kg), working in confined spaces, outdoor repairs.
Shift Work:
Rotational on-call duty for emergencies.
Travel to all sites for repair and maintenance works.

jobs.title: Civil Works/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary
The Civil Works/Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for overseeing both the design and implementation of civil infrastructure projects, as well as managing surveying activities in the field. This role requires extensive fieldwork and collaboration with project teams to ensure projects are delivered with precision, quality, and integrity. The role involves the use of advanced surveying tools and technology, as well as ensuring adherence to engineering standards and regulations.
Duties and Responsibilities
1. Project Planning and Design
Develop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, and resource allocation.
Collaborate with engineers and project managers to design civil works (roads, bridges, drainage systems, utilities).
Conduct feasibility studies and site assessments to determine project viability.
Prepare accurate engineering drawings and specifications in accordance with regulatory standards.
2. Surveying and Fieldwork
Conduct site surveys and inspections using equipment such as total stations, GPS receivers, and 3D laser scanners.
Analyze and interpret survey data to generate contour plans using Civil CAD software.
Incorporate survey data into civil infrastructure designs.
Ensure the accuracy of topography, boundaries, and measurements on-site.
3. Site Management
Oversee construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.
Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to facilitate smooth execution of project phases.
Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, address issues, and ensure project integrity.
Ensure proper implementation of survey data during construction phases.
4. Quality Assurance and Control
Ensure compliance with engineering standards, safety regulations, and quality control procedures.
Conduct material testing and maintain accurate project documentation.
Prepare progress reports and recommend corrective actions when necessary.
Document changes in project scope and manage approvals.
5. Team Collaboration and Leadership
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project goals.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technical staff.
Ensure clear and effective communication among all team members and stakeholders.
Review and approve construction methods and materials for compliance.
6. Budgeting and Resource Management
Prepare and manage project budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation.
Monitor expenditures and implement cost control measures where appropriate.
Oversee procurement processes and ensure ethical purchasing practices.
Recommend cost-saving measures while maintaining quality standards.
7. Regulatory Compliance
Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
Obtain required permits and approvals from authorities.
Conduct environmental assessments as needed.
8. Problem-Solving and Decision-Making
Identify and resolve project challenges while maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
Make informed decisions regarding project modifications or design changes.
Implement risk management strategies and address safety concerns on-site.

jobs.title: Senior Mining Engineer
jobs.industry: Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role you will assist the Mining Manager and Superintendents to provide medium, long term and /or strategic mine planning including underground mining optimization, design, production scheduling, cost estimations, underground expansion studies, administration of the computerized dispatch system, short term production and capital projects and to supervise, mentor and develop graduate mining engineers.
Key Accountabilities
Complete to the required standards, all medium, long term and/or strategic mine planning activities for underground mine incline operations, including production scheduling, reconciliation, reporting, portal optimization, design, cost estimations, along with conduct of meetings, and supervision, development and mentoring of mine planning and projects graduate.
Oversee the operation of the dispatch system to identify trends, problems, inefficiencies, or non-compliance with operating procedures, taking action or making recommendations for continuous improvement through reports and weekly system improvement meetings.
Ensure all aspects of mining operations design and planning comply with Company policy and statutory requirements including health and safety, environment, and agreement with landowners.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
About You
To be considered for this role it is essential that you must have a bachelor’s degree in mining engineering and must have mining operational experience with 5 years of technical experience in a similar role. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Experience in mining engineering, preferably in an underground environment, with sound exposure to production activities including production planning.
Strong computer skills with mine design (Surpac) and scheduling programs.
Sound knowledge of safe mining practices and standards in an underground Narrow Vein Mine.
Good written and verbal communication skills as well as good organizational and administrative skills.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

jobs.title: Project Planner or Scheduler
jobs.industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Project Management, Property and Real Estate
jobs.description:
Summary
The Project Planner / Scheduler is responsible for developing, monitoring, and updating the project schedule across all phases of construction. This role ensures alignment between time, cost, and resource planning to support on-time and on-budget delivery. The position requires close collaboration with engineers, quantity surveyors, and project managers to monitor performance and mitigate delays.
Duties and Responsibilities
1. Pre-Construction Stage
Develop the Master Project Schedule using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.
Define the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), activity sequences, durations, and dependencies.
Identify project milestones, deliverables, and critical paths for effective tracking.
Support the preparation of manpower, material, and equipment forecasts.
Coordinate with the commercial and cost teams to ensure schedule-cost alignment.
Review cost estimates with quantity surveyors and estimators for scheduling accuracy.
2. Construction Stage
Monitor actual work progress against the baseline schedule and identify variances.
Update schedules regularly based on site conditions, change orders, or revised scopes.
Highlight potential delays and assess their impact on overall project timelines.
Coordinate with project teams to propose recovery plans when needed.
Generate weekly and monthly project progress reports with visual timelines and critical path tracking.
3. Post-Construction Stage
Prepare detailed close-out schedules to support final inspections and commissioning activities.
Analyze and compare planned versus actual performance data to assess overall schedule efficiency.
Develop delay analysis and Extension of Time (EOT) reports with supporting documentation for claims.
4. Final Completion & Handover
Ensure all project planning and scheduling records are updated and properly archived.
Document lessons learned and provide input to improve future scheduling methodologies and project planning processes.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in project planning and scheduling.
Proficient in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or other recognized scheduling software.
Solid understanding of construction processes, project phases, and planning principles.
Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and coordinating with project stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively under pressure in dynamic project environments.
Full-time position based at the project office with regular visits to construction sites.
May require occasional extended hours to meet reporting deadlines or resolve schedule issues.
Work may involve outdoor site inspections in varying weather and environmental conditions.

About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of heavy underground equipment in a safe and appropriate manner. This includes Trucks, Drills, Front-end loaders, Dozers, Mobile cranes (45T & 100T), and other pieces of equipment.
Key Accountabilities
Undertaking scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance of the company's heavy vehicle fleet, including Sandvik, CAT and Normet vehicles and equipment.
Respond to machinery breakdowns promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Servicing and preventative maintenance on Jumbos, Loaders and Trucks.
Diagnosis and troubleshooting of faults, and recommending servicing interventions that improve the operational efficiency of the company's heavy vehicle fleet
Rectifying machinery breakdowns in an underground environment promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Ensuring completion of all shift paperwork including service sheets, work orders and daily shift reports.
Completing all JSA's, risk assessments and documentation to ensure all work is completed safely and as per schedule.
Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to Trade Assistant’s and apprentice.
About You
Qualifications & Experience
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting with 3+ years’ experience in mining environment or heavy construction industry. In addition to this, you will have
Experience with Mining Equipment like Drills, LHD Loaders, Caterpillar Equipment, Sandvik Equipment etc.
Experience fitter with hydraulics training background.
Experience in the use of Pronto will be advantageous.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

Summary
The Senior MEP Engineer plays a pivotal role in managing and coordinating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within construction projects. Their responsibilities extend to designing, reviewing, and overseeing MEP systems, ensuring adherence to relevant codes and standards. With expertise in BIM modeling, particularly in Navisworks and Revit, they lead the integration of these systems into the overall building design. They coordinate with various stakeholders, lead BIM coordination meetings, and mentor junior staff, ensuring seamless integration and efficient functionality of MEP components within complex construction environments.
Duties and Responsibilities
Responsible for carrying out a variety of basic field duties at the job design related to the general construction and maintenance.
Study the project scope of works, Owner requirements, BOQ, project milestones, and specification from the supplied bid documents.
Take note of possible queries to be brought up to the owner for clarifications.
Conduct material inquiries with the related suppliers nominated by Procurement.
Evaluate contractor or supplier’s proposal to ensure conformity with project requirements.
Prepare estimates on manpower and construction tools & equipment to be utilized.
Acquire material submittals from selected suppliers and prepare submittals according to project requirements.
Provide technical directions to the construction to ensure designs and drawings are prepared according to project requirement.
Prepare design, drawing and technical requirements.
Utilize BIM (Building Information Modeling) to create, manage, and optimize building designs.
Collaborate with project teams using BIM tools, primarily Navisworks and Revit, for design coordination and clash detection.
Lead BIM coordination meetings and manage the BIM workflow within the project team.
Implement BIM best practices and standards in all design phases.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship in BIM processes to junior engineers and team members.
Carry out additional related works as directed by the Design & Planning Manager or Project Director.
Works with Design & Planning Manager or Project Director on instructions for any amendments to drawing documents and other related issues.
Job Requirements
Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Specialist Diploma in M&E Coordination will be an advantage.
A minimum of 12-15 years' experience in Design, development and consultant or real estate field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in a related engineering discipline, with a focus on BIM implementation in large-scale projects.
Technically sound on applicable codes, standards, and regulations based on AS/NZS and PNG Local Authorities.
Proficiency in BIM modeling, with at least an intermediate level of experience.
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Navisworks and Revit BIM Modeling software.
Demonstrated experience in managing BIM projects and coordinating multidisciplinary design teams.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to lead BIM discussions and resolve complex issues.
Familiarity with BIM standards, such as ISO 19650, and other relevant industry standards.
Ability to conduct electrical mechanical analysis and calculations.
Ability to work under pressure and tight schedules.

jobs.title: Underground Short Interval Control Officer
jobs.industry: Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our Underground Mining team you will be an integral part of K92’s Mine Control Centre (MCC). The SIC Officer will assist the Shift Supervisors and Mine Coordinators throughout the shift to optimse the outcomes in line with the weekly plan, using the information flowing through the MCC and the use of the live Deswik.OPS Gantt mine schedule.
The SIC Officer will collaborate with the Supervisors throughout the shift, guiding them on opportunities, status updates from the MCC, coordinating requirements from technical services and generally assisting wherever possible.
The SIC officer will prepare a draft 36-hour shift plan for the Supervisors in readiness for the shift hand over, manage Deswik.OPS live weekly schedules, maintain compliance to plan dashboards and have daily reports prepared with validated data.
In addition, the SIC Officer will be required to identify data driven improvement opportunities, using PowerBI dashboards and analytics of the data recorded into Deswik.OPS.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure all personnel, contractors and visitors comply with site and contractual HSE requirements.
Ensure work is planned so it can be conducted safely, with consideration for environmental conditions, nearby activities, people, and other resources needed to complete the work.
Ensure housekeeping activities within and around the work area are performed to a high standard.
Actively promote a safety first, zero harm culture.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (HSE, Supervisors, Coordinators, Superintendents, MTS personnel, Mine Controllers) to support the Mining Supervisor to execute their responsibilities on a shift-by-shift basis.
Promote a data-driven continuous improvement by reviewing Power BI dashboards and completing data analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
Maintain, in real time the Deswik.OPS Gantt schedule through the shift to weekly time horizons,
Collaborate with the Mine Supervisors across the mine radio to prepare a detail 36-hour shift plan for review in each shift planning meeting.
Provide Supervisors with any mobile equipment status changes because of either Planned or Breakdown maintenance
In consultation with the underground supervisors, provide the Mobile Maintenance teams with clear priorities for break down repairs.
Inform the Supervisor of upcoming planning conflicts based on the live shift progress (on the Deswik.OPS Gantt), to proactive make changes throughout the shift, optimising the shift plan.
Coordinate with the Underground Supervisors to ensure shotcrete orders and delivery time frames are managed to achieve the shift and weekly objectives
Coordinate with the stores department to ensure consumables are available for the mining team to deliver the plan
Maintain the compliance to plan control charts (Development, Production, Slot Drilling) on the muster room dashboards, meeting rooms and daily reports
Maintain the end of week forecast of mining key physicals
The SIC Officer will maintain a dashboard and memo register to clearly identifying the upcoming requirement for development designs and survey control
Maintain KPI’s on a daily, weekly and monthly basis as defined in the K92 MOS
Produce delay Pareto charts each day, week and month to understand key operational improvement opportunities
Use the Deswik.OPS data and Power BI to identify continuous improvement opportunities
Use the Deswik.OPS data and Power BI to produce reports which measure the success of current CI projects.
Escalate delays through the K92 MOS escalation TARP as required
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Minimum of 3 years' experience in underground mining, with an in depth understanding of the mining cycle
Preferably tertiary qualifications in a Mining related field
High level of computer literacy in MS Office suite and data management
High degree of analytical, planning and scheduling skills
Strong communication skills with ability to communicate with wide range of disciplines on site
Experience in directing, monitoring and adjusting shift plans and reports
Experience in Deswik Software or Similar
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

We’re Hiring: Senior Sales Manager – Port Moresby
Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby
Holiday Inn Express Port Moresby
At Holiday Inn, we’re all about making travel easier and more enjoyable for our guests — and that starts with the people who bring our brand to life. If you’re a relationship-builder, a natural connector, and someone who loves driving commercial results while keeping things genuine and human, we’d love to meet you.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in Port Moresby, supporting both Holiday Inn & Suites and Holiday Inn Express. In this portfolio role, you’ll develop strong partnerships, unlock new business opportunities, and lead the charge in growing our market share across key segments.
You’ll report directly to the Portfolio Director of Sales & Marketing and play a key role in shaping the commercial success of our two hotels.
What You’ll Do
Lead sales activity across key corporate, government, group, and long-stay segments
Build meaningful client relationships that feel like family — the Holiday Inn way
Create smart sales strategies that drive revenue, grow share, and strengthen the brand
Support the development of proactive and reactive sales structures
Work closely with Marketing, Reservations, and Operations to deliver a seamless guest and partner experience
Represent our hotels at trade events, client meetings, and familiarisations
Mentor and support junior team members as we grow the next generation of IHG talent
What We’re Looking For
Proven hotel sales experience, ideally within an international brand
Strong communication and presentation skills
A proactive, positive, can-do approach
Ability to build trust quickly and maintain long-lasting partnerships
Commercially savvy, organised, and comfortable managing a fast-moving portfolio
Someone who embodies the Holiday Inn spirit – warm, open, and genuinely helpful
What we need from you
3-5 years hotel experience (international brand preferred)
Strong experience with government, corporate, or mining accounts.
Proven ability to meet revenue targets and manage key accounts.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Understanding of Port Moresby market dynamics.
Join us today!
In return for your hard work, you can look forward to a highly competitive salary and benefits package. What’s more, because your career will be as unique as you are, we’ll give you all the tailored support you need to make a great start, be involved and grow.
And because the Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby brand belongs to the IHG® family of brands, you’ll also benefit from all of the opportunities that come from being part of a successful, global hospitality company with over 4800 hotels in over 100 countries around the world.
So, whoever you are, whatever you love doing, bring your passion to Holiday Inn and IHG and we’ll make sure you’ll have room to be yourself.

jobs.title: Grants Lead
jobs.description:
About Palladium
Palladium is a global leader in the design, development, and delivery of Positive Impact – the intentional creation of enduring social, climate and economic value.  We work with governments, businesses, and investors to help solve the world's most pressing challenges. With a team of more than 2,000 employees operating in 75-plus countries and a global network of over 35,000 experts, we help improve economies, societies, the environment, and, most importantly, people's lives.
About PNG-Australia Strongim Wok Long TVET (SWLT)
The Papua New Guinea (PNG)–Australia Strongim Wok Long Technical and Vocational Education and Training (SWLT) program is a new Australian Government investment that will be working in partnership with PNG to strengthen its technical and vocational education and training (TVET) sector. Aligned with PNG’s national priority to build an educated and skilled workforce for resilient economic growth, SWLT aims to enhance the quality, relevance, and inclusiveness of skills development. The program will work closely with TVET stakeholders and select technical colleges to grow the number of skilled individuals with industry relevant skills.
This Opportunity
As Grants Lead you will be responsible for establishing and managing a diverse program of grants through a range of modalities that will support TVET stakeholders to deliver demand-driven and inclusive TVET initiatives.
This will include:
Working with national TVET stakeholders to develop small and large grant streams
Drafting and implementing a Grants Management Framework
Ensuring compliance with DFAT and Palladium policies, guidelines and systems
Preparing grant agreements and overseeing financial management, compliance and performance
Developing tailored capacity-building systems for grantees
Supporting public diplomacy, MEL and internal process improvements and program adaptation
Contributing to gender equality, disability and social inclusion objectives and safeguarding activities
​
Please note:
This role is being advertised early in the program’s inception phase. Some aspects of the role may be revised before or shortly after commencement. Any changes will be discussed and agreed upon between Palladium and the successful candidate.
Fixed term contract up to 31 December 2027 (with possible 2 year extension)
Based in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
Open to PNG national candidates only
To Apply
Please submit your application directly to Palladium using this link:
https://thepalladiumgroup.com/joblist
Include your CV and a brief cover letter, outlining your suitability in line with the requirements of the position.
Closing date:
Monday 8th December 2025, 11.59pm AEST
Please note that applications will be assessed on a rolling basis.
Equity, Diversity & Inclusion
- Palladium is committed to embedding equity, diversity, and inclusion into everything we do. We welcome applications from all sections of society and actively encourage diversity to drive innovation, creativity, success and good practice. We positively welcome and seek to ensure we achieve diversity in our workforce; and that all job applicants and employees receive equal and fair treatment regardless of their background or personal characteristics. These include: (but are not limited to) socio-economic background, age, race, gender identity and expression, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, veteran, marital or Indigenous status.
Should you require any adjustments or accommodations to be made due to a disability or you are a neurodivergent individual or for any other circumstance, please email our team at
[email protected]
and we will be in touch to discuss.
Safeguarding
- We define Safeguarding as “the preventative action taken by Palladium to protect our people, clients and the communities we work with from harm”. We are committed to ensuring that all children and adults who come into contact with Palladium are treated with respect and are free from abuse. All successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced selection process including safeguarding-focused interviews and a rigorous due diligence process.
About you
You will have experience:
Working with donor funded partnership agreements and grants schemes, particularly in leadership and systems development
Drafting and managing grant agreements, and management and experience in financial management, compliance systems and fraud control, acquittals and audits
Using grants management systems, such as SmartyGrants
Demonstrated experience of key Australian Government aid delivery policies (including the Commonwealth
Procurement Rules, Grant Rules and Guidelines and DFAT’s Safeguarding policies)
Participation and positive engagement in diverse teams, supporting a results-driven culture of learning and inclusion

12 months fixed term contract, with possible extension
Based in Port Moresby
Join an NGO that’s human-first, impact-driven, and fun to work with
About Catalpa
At Catalpa, we’re all about creating real impact. We’re a global development organisation that believes bright ideas—mixed with technology, creativity, and local know-how—can solve tough challenges.
Our team is a mix of engineers, designers, educators, economists, and project delivery folk. Together, we work on projects that matter and actually change lives. One of the things we’re most proud of?  Making learning accessible and engaging for communities that are often left out.  Our work is meaningful, innovative, and, honestly, pretty cool. Check us out at
www.catalpa.io
About the position
We are picking up the pace with projects in PNG, and as Catalpa continues to grow, so does our appetite for awesome talent.
Right now, we are on the lookout for a Finance and Operations Coordinator. This role is central to the smooth, timely, and compliant delivery of Catalpa’s projects in Papua New Guinea.  You’ll be our PNG team problem solver and connector—providing essential day-to-day support across finance, administration, procurement, logistics, operations, and safety and security, and working closely with our project teams to keep our activities running efficiently.
In this role, the Coordinator will help maintain strong operational systems, ensure financial and procurement compliance, and contribute to the continual improvement of Catalpa’s processes. The position supports teams in planning and implementing activities, managing resources, and resolving operational challenges as they arise.  By providing reliable, responsive, and high-quality support, the Finance and Operations Coordinator helps ensure Catalpa’s PNG programs operate effectively and uphold organisational and donor requirements.
A detailed Terms of Reference for this position
can be found here
.
Requirements
We’d love to meet someone who has:
Minimum 3 years of experience in a finance and/or operations role, preferably within the international development or NGO context.
Relevant qualifications in management, administration, finance, HR, international development, or a related field.
Demonstrated knowledge and experience in supporting the day to day management of an office and team environment - supporting teams, meeting deadlines and achieving outputs.
You’ll be tech savvy and find it easy to learn IT systems such as Xero, Slack and Googlesuite.
Experience in a similar role where organising and prioritising tasks is a part of your everyday life.
Working knowledge of general office administration and logistics processes is essential.  You’ll have experience across these areas:
Day to day financial processes including accounts payable
Procurement and asset management
Logistics such as organising events, travel, liaising with suppliers, vehicle management, IT support
Being  a point of contact for safety and security support for staff
Knowledge of PNG labour, immigration, and payroll requirements.
A full PNG driver’s licence is essential!
We seek a self-driven, proactive and dynamic candidate with strong inter-personal and communication skills for building and maintaining relationships with teams, key stakeholders and service providers.
Extra awesome if you bring:
Strong financial management skills with experience using accounting systems (Xero desirable).
Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines under pressure.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to challenges.
Eligibility
We love working with smart people from diverse backgrounds who are willing to learn new things. There are many skills we think this job will make use of but feel free to apply even if you’re not a ‘perfect fit’.
Work environment
We work in a creative, supportive environment with colleagues who come from diverse walks of life, and we value the perspectives they bring. We pay attention to the details, and we work together to achieve the best we can. Importantly, we work here because we love what we do and the impact we can have.
We know people’s lives include many obligations outside of work, so we aim to create a flexible work environment that includes remote work options, generous family leave, and return-to-work policies to support new parents. We know we do our best work when we take care of ourselves and communities. We take two weeks off at the end of each year to recharge and refresh.
Fit
Catalpa staff believe in the potential of technology to transform lives for the better. Our team members are flexible and can handle working across a broad range of responsibilities. They don’t mind rolling up their sleeves to solve thorny challenges that take time, patience, and creativity. We are friendly and care about the people with whom we work, always seeking to build and nurture relationships for the long-term.
Catalpa seeks to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity for all people, regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or marital status. We especially welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds.
Catalpa prioritises the safeguarding of all people, including the prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment and the safeguarding of children. Reporting to the Senior Surveyor, the Surveyor, Survey Underground is responsible for providing accurate and timely survey services to support safe and effective mine development and production activities. The role ensures the integrity of underground control networks, compliance with statutory mine survey standards and the availability for reliable spatial data for planning, engineering and operational decision -making.

At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
As Specialist, External Relations, you will drive Newmont’s success by developing and leading stakeholder engagement plans, supporting operations, and enhancing our license to operate across Asia Pacific. Your work will build strong relationships with government agencies and help shape policy and regulatory outcomes that matter.
As Part of Our Team, You Will
Apply government relations strategies at national and provincial levels
Build and sustain networks with government agencies, regulators, and policymakers
Advise on policy, regulatory, and political trends impacting operations
Develop and manage stakeholder engagement plans
Support Newmont’s interests within national and provincial governments
Implement governance and policies for government affairs
Proactively identify and mitigate external risks
Collaborate with peers to develop and implement country strategies
Prerequisites for Your Success in This Role
Degree in law, economics, international relations, social science, or related field (preferred)
Advanced knowledge in stakeholder management, government engagement, policy, or advocacy
Strong skills in strategy development, advocacy, political risk management, and communications
Proficiency with major office systems (e.g., MS Office)
Self-awareness, adaptability, and commitment to continuous improvement
Ability to build relationships, influence, and negotiate effectively
Your Work Environment
You will operate in a dynamic, high-impact environment at the intersection of business, government, and society. This role involves regular engagement with senior government officials, regulatory bodies, and internal executive leadership. As part of Newmont’s Corporate Affairs function, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s long-term success and sustaining its social license to operate in Papua New Guinea.
Based in Port Moresby, this position presents a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact on government relations and policy engagement in support of responsible mining and sustainable development in the region.
If you're ready to take on a meaningful challenge where your expertise can shape the future of mining in Papua New Guinea, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and lead the change!
Why Join Newmont
Newmont is the world’s leading gold company, committed to sustainable and responsible mining. As part of our team, you will:
Influence national policy and drive meaningful change in the mining sector.
Work alongside global leaders in a values-driven, inclusive organization.
Access world-class professional development and leadership opportunities.
Be part of a company that prioritizes safety, integrity, sustainability, and respect in everything we do.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.

Load, program and optimise radio codeplugs, channels, zones, and network features.
Interpret radio schematics, service manuals, and alignment procedures.
Conduct RF testing including power output, deviation, modulation, SINAD, BER and VSWR.
Complete firmware updates, feature activation and calibration to manufacturer standards.

Maintain documentation for repair findings, parts used, and test results.

Tools, Equipment & Safety

About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This Senior Electrical Engineer will play a key role in the successful delivery of the stage 3 mine expansion for the Kainantu Mine Operation. Reporting to the Project Manager - Projects & Engineering, the Senior Electrical Engineer will provide technical expertise and analysis of the operation of the electrical power system, including generation, sub transmission and reticulation network, HV machinery and aux electrical systems design and construction.
You will be responsible for managing the technical aspects of all electrical projects and ensuring that the projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the required design/electrical standards. The Senior Electrical Engineer will work closely with the project managers, Contractors, engineering and consultants to develop and implement project plans, schedules and budgets, and will also be responsible for managing the day-to-day technical aspects of all power and electrical projects.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure integrity of protection and earthing system design
Provide recommendations for design and maintenance of electrical equipment such as transformers, switchgear etc.
Act as K92 representative for electrical HV design, equipment selection, sizing, etc, for projects
Ownership of K92 site fault study & protection reports and reviews
Ownership of K92 site load management philosophy reports and reviews
Delivers work within approved budget managing any variances in accordance with escalation process.
Lead all electrical engineering matters including design changes and development, engineering reviews, construction reviews, acceptance of site changes, compliance with codes and standards.
Manage the electrical engineering change register.
Oversee the development of electrical engineering project briefs, technical specifications, and designs including drawings and bill-of-quantities.
Carry out technical and feasibility studies and draw up blueprints that satisfy technical specifications.
Conduct on site investigations and analyze data (maps, reports, tests, drawings and other).
Takes an active role in promoting the training and development.
Responsible for project design, developing scope of works, work schedule and QA/QC.

jobs.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
As an Advisor - Registered Mine Electrician (RME) Delegate, you will play a critical role in ensuring electrical safety, compliance, and operational excellence across site operations. Your work will directly support a safe and efficient workplace by upholding standards, mentoring others, and maintaining regulatory compliance.
As Part of Our Team, You Will
Conduct field critical control checks and ensure proper isolation processes.
Lead investigations into electrical safety incidents and implement corrective actions.
Authorize and issue electrical permits, access keys, and maintain compliance records.
Support training, coaching, and development of electrical personnel.
Ensure all electrical work meets Australian standards and Newmont specifications.
Liaise with departments to clarify site electrical requirements and standards.
Review and approve energization notifications and electrical licenses.
Participate in audits, risk assessments, and compliance documentation.
Prerequisites for Your Success in This Role
Qualifications: Certificate III in Electrotechnology is essential. A High Voltage Switching Certificate, LVR/CPR, and EEHA certification are preferred.
Licensing: PNG Power Authority or Australian/NZ State Electrical License is essential.
Knowledge: Familiarity with PNG Mining (Safety) Act, AS/NZS 3000, 3007, 4871, 3012, and 60079 standards is essential.
Skills: Strong problem-solving, practical judgment, and ability to work independently.
People Skills: Effective communicator, team collaborator, and adaptable to diverse work environments.
Your Work Environment
This role is based at Newmont’s Lihir Island site within the Asset Management team, supporting Fixed Plant Maintenance and Reliability. It is an individual contributor position focused on fieldwork, compliance, and stakeholder engagement.
For this opportunity, Lihir offers a 22:20 FIFO roster from a range of designated marshalling points. FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, with en-suited, air-conditioned rooms equipped with a mini fridge, TV, and Wi-Fi. Healthy meals are provided at the mess, and the wet mess offers a relaxed social setting with pool and darts. Recreational facilities include an on-site gym and basketball court, while paid members can enjoy the Lihir Sports and Social Club, featuring a swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, a restaurant/bar, and a deck with stunning Pacific Ocean views. A café and deli are also available for takeaway coffee, snacks, and groceries.
Newmont employees benefit from a competitive salary package, salary packaging options, and an annual incentive program.
Why Join Newmont
Be part of a global leader in mining committed to safety, sustainability, and innovation.
Work in a collaborative environment that values your expertise and supports your growth.
Make a meaningful impact by ensuring the safety and reliability of critical infrastructure.
Access to ongoing training, development, and career advancement opportunities.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond.
We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply before the closing date: 8th December 2025 – we’d love to hear from you!

Introduction
WaterAid’s vision is of a world where everyone has access to safe water and sanitation. Our mission is to transform lives by improving access to safe water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) in the world’s poorest communities. WaterAid works with partners to maximise its impacts for policy change/influence.
WaterAid has been operating in Papua New Guinea (PNG) since 2004, working with local partners and the government to increase access to gender sensitive, socially inclusive water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) services. WaterAid PNG’s geographic focus is within the National Capital District, Central Province in the Southern Region, East Sepik Province in the Momase region and East New Britain Province in the New Guinea Islands. We work nationally through a system strengthening approach with the Government of PNG.
Everything we do is shaped by our six values:
Integrity
Respect
Collaboration
Courage
Accountability
Innovation
WaterAid is a child safe organisation. We recognise that we must meet community expectations, and the trust placed in our personnel to maintain the highest standards of conduct with children. Therefore, all positions within WaterAid are required to comply with our Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct.
WaterAid is committed to protection from sexual exploitation and abuse in everything we do. The values and standards we uphold are highlighted in our Global Code of Conduct. All positions within WaterAid are required to comply with our Global Code of Conduct.
Position Summary
WaterAid is seeking a highly motivated individual with strong leadership, capacity development abilities, program and grant management expertise, and technical experience in Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WaSH) to join our team as the Senior Program Manager (SPM) for our East New Britain programs.
In line with the National WASH Policy (2015-2030), WaterAid is committed to supporting the Government of PNG to reach universal access to water, sanitation and hygiene. The SPM will support WaterAid’s East New Britain Program team through overseeing two key grants, the PacFresh H2O program
[1]
in Rabaul and Pomio Districts, and the KIWA initiative grant in Rabaul District.
The Senior Program Manager (SPM) will oversee a wide range of responsibilities, including leading program implementation, ensuring quality and compliance and managing a team of approximately 12 East New Britain based professionals. The role will involve close collaboration with local and national government partners, as well as WaterAid PNG Port Moresby based HQ and regional team based in Australia.
About the Grants
The SPM will also provide strategic and operational leadership for two key grants:
The
Protecting Freshwater Resources in the Pacific (PacFresh H2O) Project
aims to strengthen the climate resilience of rural communities in Rabaul and Pomio districts by improving access to safe, reliable water and sanitation, protecting freshwater resources, and advancing gender equality and social inclusion. Through a system-strengthening approach, the project builds the skills of local decision-makers and community groups, improves coordination and planning, implements priority measures to address water insecurity, and supports the scale-up of climate-resilient WASH approaches through stronger policy integration, learning and financing. The project ensures that women, people with disabilities and other marginalised groups benefit from more resilient WASH services and improved livelihoods.
The
Kiwa Initiative Preserve Project
aims to strengthens climate resilience in vulnerable rural and coastal communities by protecting and restoring freshwater and watershed ecosystems through nature-based solutions. The project seeks to improve reliable access to safe water, reduce climate-related risks such as droughts, flooding and contamination, and promote community-led resource management that embeds gender equality, disability inclusion and local knowledge. By building the capacity of government partners, community groups and rights-holder organisations, the project embeds sustainable ecosystem management practices and supports more resilient and secure livelihoods in the face of increasing climate impacts.
Key Performance Areas/Accountabilities
Program Management
Be responsible for managing and reporting on all grant activities whilst building the grant and program management capacity of the team. To do this the SPM will work closely with Programs Team members, the Operations Team in PNG and the Program support team in WaterAid Australia Melbourne Office to ensure compliance with grant management requirements.
Ensure all WaterAid Programs are high quality from a WaSH technical and a development effectiveness perspective, reflecting latest evidence and thinking, and adapted to suit the PNG context.
The SPM reports to the Country Director in Port Moresby and as a member of the Senior Management Team, will support the Country Director in leading WaterAid PNG, and shaping our strategies and work with the sector.
Strengthen capacity of the WaterAid’s East New Britain team to manage and develop programs.
Ensure that programs and projects satisfy minimum criteria defined in WaterAid Guidelines and PNG Government policy, law and regulation and WaterAid’s Quality Program Standards.
Work with staff to prepare project plans and arrange team meetings to monitor progress and manage any risks that may be identified.
Ensure that Partner organisations and contractors are sensitised on approaches for ensuring that water supply, sanitation and hygiene promotion services are sustainable.
Support the strengthening of the sector based on clear objectives for improving local government capacity to increase access to WASH services.
Assist the Operations Manager and Country Director to monitor expenditure, manage fraud risks and ensure that WaterAid and donor standards regarding financial management are met by WaterAid staff and partner organisations.
Ensure timely processing of acquittals and follow up audit findings and recommendations, as appropriate.
Monitoring, Evaluation, Knowledge and Learning
Build capacity of the team to monitor and evaluate activities and foster a culture within the team conducive to learning, sharing and innovation.
Support advocacy work with partners and engage constructively with a range of stakeholders to progress advocacy objectives.
Facilitate reflection on project delivery and promote a culture of continuous learning among WaterAid staff and our partners.
Support the documentation of learning and work with the team to measure the impact of programs and the efficacy of program implementation.
Lead and coordinate the programs team in timely reporting, documenting progress and achievement of project outputs and outcomes in line with donor requirements.
Equity and Inclusion
Support partners and staff to engage effectively with women, people with disabilities and marginalised members of the community throughout project planning and review processes.
Identify opportunities to further engage the community in the planning, monitoring and review of WASH services and work with local authorities and community representatives to design and implement feedback mechanisms about community access to water, sanitation and hygiene services.
Build the capacity and understanding of the WaterAid Team on gender, equity and inclusion and how to ensure WaterAid programs are inclusive.
Consult with the regional GEDSI Advisor on the equity and inclusion aspects of the work and ensure that WaterAid staff and external stakeholders are sensitive to gender and social inclusion considerations.
Promote a ‘Do No Harm’ approach amongst WaterAid staff and partners and ensure that referral pathways are accessible for stakeholders and beneficiaries.
Staff Management
Support and mentor the development of WaterAid staff and build their capacity, personal and professional development.
Conduct staff appraisals and provide ongoing, constructive feedback on staff performance and opportunities for growth and development.
Identify staff capacity development needs, prepare staff development plans and provide staff training in coordination with the Operations Manager and Country Director.
Promote a culture of respect, collaboration. Learning and sharing building on WaterAid’s values.
Ensure WaterAid security policy and protocols are adhered to by staff.
Partner Engagement
Maintain constructive working relationships with WaterAid’s local partners.
Attend regular meetings with partners to discuss project design and delivery, reflect on progress, identify risks and challenges and jointly propose solutions.
Coordinate field visits with partners and donors with sensitivity to security and accessibility issues.
Represent WaterAid through local sector coordination bodies.
The role requires engagement with a moderate degree of complexity, due to the need to:
Coordinate with multiple stakeholders, including formal program partners, as well as community leaders, traditional landowners and government agencies.
Assist the Country Director and Operations Manager with management of a large grant with complex financial and compliance requirements, with multiple separate activities
Ensure that risks concerning financial mismanagement and fraud are adequately managed.
